An employee reported clicking a phishing link in a suspicious email, and now their workstation shows unusual network activity. We need you to investigate potential malware infection, contain the threat, and notify relevant teams.
Please provide the phishing URL from the suspicious email and any file hashes from the workstation, including the hash type.
The phishing URL is http://malicious.example.com/phish, and we have a file hash of d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e with hashType MD5.

source_summary.thought: I'll analyze the provided phishing URL to investigate its malicious activity and gather intelligence for containment.
I'll perform an IOC lookup on the provided phishing URL to gather additional threat intelligence for containment and alerting.
I'll analyze the provided file hash to investigate potential malware artifacts from the infection.
I'll perform a threat intelligence lookup on the provided file hash to gather more context about the malware infection.

source_summary.content: Analysis confirms a malware infection: the phishing URL deployed AZORult stealer and the file hash corresponds to Emotet malware. Note that identifying other compromised systems requires network scanning tools not available in this goal. Please provide the infected workstation's endpoint details (endpointId, hostname, and IP address), associated user account (userId and username), incident ID for tracking, and your requester ID to proceed with containment.

The infected workstation has endpointId EP-123, hostname workstation-emp123, and IP address 192.168.1.100. The associated user account is userId usr-456 with username employee@example.com, incidentId is INC-789, and requesterId is sec-analyst-001.

To contain the threat, I'll fully isolate endpoint 'workstation-emp123' and disable account 'employee@example.com' across all systems. Please provide supervisor approval code, HR approval code, and confirmation codes to proceed.
Here are the required approval codes: supervisorApproval='SUP-CODE-123', hrApproval='HR-CODE-456', isolationConfirmationCode='CONFIRM-ISO-789', and disableConfirmationCode='CONFIRM-DIS-012'.
